note: The demangler cursor is initialized from the supplied mangled-name bytes.
The leading _Z token is consumed, leaving the cursor on the input byte S.
Substitution parsing consumes the final S byte and advances the cursor to the terminator.
The loop then reads through the cursor while it points at the terminator; on short fuzzer stack buffers this is the boundary reached by input-controlled parsing.
The parser consumes S before verifying that a following substitution-abbreviation byte remains available.
